entry.en: A visitor's passport must usually be valid at least 6 months after arrival and have at least 2 blank pages for entry stamps.
entry.es: El pasaporte de un visitante normalmente debe ser válido al menos 6 meses tras la llegada y tener al menos 2 páginas en blanco para sellos.
entry.quote: your passport must usually have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least 2 blank pages for entry stamps.

entry.en: You can only enter Azerbaijan via air travel without restrictions; entry by land or sea is restricted.
entry.es: Solo se puede entrar a Azerbaiyán por vía aérea sin restricciones; la entrada por tierra o mar está restringida.
entry.quote: You can only enter Azerbaijan via air travel without restrictions. Entry via a land or sea border is restricted.

entry.en: If you want to leave Azerbaijan by road, you need permission from the authorities.
entry.es: Si quieres salir de Azerbaiyán por carretera, necesitas permiso de las autoridades.
entry.quote: If you want to leave Azerbaijan by road, you need permission from the authorities.

entry.en: Anyone who visited certain areas of south-western Azerbaijan, including Khankendi, without permission could be denied entry.
entry.es: A quien haya visitado sin permiso ciertas zonas del suroeste de Azerbaiyán, incluida Khankendi, se le podría denegar la entrada.
entry.quote: Anyone who has previously visited certain areas in south-western Azerbaijan, including the town of Khankendi, without the permission of the Azerbaijani authorities could be denied entry to Azerbaijan.

entry.en: Foreigners staying longer than 15 days should register with the State Migration Service within 15 working days of arrival.
entry.es: Los extranjeros que permanezcan más de 15 días deben registrarse en el Servicio Estatal de Migración en un plazo de 15 días hábiles tras la llegada.
entry.quote: Foreigners staying in Azerbaijan for longer than 15 days should register with the State Migration Service within 15 working days of arrival.

entry.en: A fake official eVisa website, evisa.com.az, exists and requires buying an overpriced tour or hotel.
entry.es: Existe un sitio falso de eVisa, evisa.com.az, que exige comprar un tour o un hotel sobrevalorado.
entry.quote: Caution: there is a fake official website: evisa.com.az – also providing visas but requiring you to purchase an overpriced tour or expensive hotel.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Azerbaijan.
safety.es: Es probable que terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Azerbaiyán.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Azerbaijan.

safety.en: Avoid large gatherings and demonstrations, which are illegal and could bring a swift response from the authorities.
safety.es: Evita las grandes concentraciones y manifestaciones, que son ilegales y podrían provocar una respuesta rápida de las autoridades.
safety.quote: Avoid large gatherings and any demonstrations. They are illegal and there could be a swift response from the authorities.

safety.en: Crime in Baku is generally low, but be alert to bag-snatching or mugging, with higher risk after dark in the centre.
safety.es: El crimen en Bakú suele ser bajo, pero hay que estar atento a tirones de bolso o atracos, con más riesgo de noche en el centro.
safety.quote: Crime levels in Baku are generally low. Be alert to possible bag-snatching or mugging, particularly if you are carrying large amounts of cash or valuables. The risk is higher after dark in the centre of town.

safety.en: Take care against card skimming; use ATMs inside banks where possible.
safety.es: Ten cuidado con el skimming de tarjetas; usa cajeros dentro de bancos cuando sea posible.
safety.quote: Use ATMs inside banks where possible, check street ATMs for signs of tampering, and always keep your card in sight when paying in shops and restaurants.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to some areas of south-western Azerbaijan because of leftover military equipment and weapons.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja los viajes no esenciales a algunas zonas del suroeste de Azerbaiyán por restos de equipo militar y armas.
safety.quote: advises against all but essential travel to some areas in south-western Azerbaijan, including districts in and around the region formerly known as “Nagorno-Karabakh” due to the risks from leftover military equipment and weapons from former conflict.

safety.en: Criminals posing as police officers have sometimes stopped foreigners and stolen documents and money.
safety.es: Delincuentes que se hacen pasar por policías han detenido a veces a extranjeros y robado documentos y dinero.
safety.quote: Criminals posing as police officers have sometimes stopped foreigners and stolen documents and money.

health.en: Medical facilities outside Baku are very limited, and serious illness may require evacuation even from Baku.
health.es: Los servicios médicos fuera de Bakú son muy limitados y una enfermedad grave puede requerir evacuación incluso desde Bakú.
health.quote: Medical facilities outside Baku are very limited. Carry a comprehensive first aid kit for any trips out of Baku. Even in Baku, serious illness or injury may require evacuation to Turkey or Western Europe.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in some parts of Azerbaijan, including Shahdag and Tufangdag ski resorts and the Talysh mountains.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas zonas de Azerbaiyán, como las estaciones de esquí de Shahdag y Tufangdag y las montañas Talysh.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in some parts of Azerbaijan, including the ski resorts of Shahdag and Tufangdag in the Gusar district, Lake Batabat in Nakhchivan, and the Talysh mountains.

health.en: Water should not be consumed unless from a sealed bottle.
health.es: No se debe consumir agua que no sea de una botella sellada.
health.quote: Water should not be consumed unless from a sealed bottle.

health.en: Malaria is a risk in lowland Azerbaijan, particularly around the border with Iran.
health.es: La malaria es un riesgo en las tierras bajas de Azerbaiyán, sobre todo cerca de la frontera con Irán.
health.quote: Malaria is a risk in lowland Azerbaijan, particularly around the border with Iran.

help.en: Emergency numbers in Azerbaijan are ambulance 103, fire 101 and police 102.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Azerbaiyán son ambulancia 103, bomberos 101 y policía 102.

help.en: If you find a landmine or unexploded weapon, do not touch it and notify the authorities on 102 or 112.
help.es: Si encuentras una mina o arma sin explotar, no la toques y avisa a las autoridades al 102 o 112.
help.quote: If you come across an unexploded weapon or landmine do not approach it or touch it. Make a note of where you saw it and notify the authorities on 102 or 112.

getting_in.en: As of May 2026 the only legal way into Azerbaijan is through an international airport, as most land borders are closed.
getting_in.es: En mayo de 2026 la única vía legal para entrar a Azerbaiyán es un aeropuerto internacional, pues la mayoría de fronteras terrestres están cerradas.
getting_in.quote: As of May 2026, most of Azerbaijan's land borders with its neighbours remain closed to civilian traffic. The only legal way into the country is through an international airport.

getting_in.en: Land crossings are exit-only, and only for non-citizens.
getting_in.es: Los pasos terrestres son solo de salida y únicamente para no ciudadanos.
getting_in.quote: Land crossings are exit-only, and only for non-citizens.

getting_around.en: Buses and marshrutkas connect most cities, often from a hub near the bazaar.
getting_around.es: Autobuses y marshrutkas conectan la mayoría de ciudades, a menudo desde una estación cerca del bazar.
getting_around.quote: Buses and marshrutkas (aka minibus aka converted delivery van) connect most cities. There is often a hub such as a bus station near the bazaar in these cities.

getting_around.en: A rule of thumb for bus fares is about 1 manat per hour of ride or per 40-50 km.
getting_around.es: Como regla general, el billete de autobús ronda 1 manat por hora de trayecto o por cada 40-50 km.
getting_around.quote: A common rule of thumb for bus rates in Azerbaijan seems to be about 1 manat per hour ride or for every 40-50 km

getting_around.en: With a few exceptions, trains are night trains connecting Baku with distant regions.
getting_around.es: Con pocas excepciones, los trenes son nocturnos y conectan Bakú con regiones lejanas.
getting_around.quote: With a few exceptions, trains in Azerbaijan are night trains that connect Baku with distant regions of the country.

getting_around.en: Most taxi drivers simply double the price for tourists, and Bolt can be used as a price indicator or to book.
getting_around.es: La mayoría de los taxistas simplemente duplican el precio a los turistas; Bolt sirve de referencia o para reservar.
getting_around.quote: Most taxi drivers simply double the price for tourists.

getting_around.en: Bolt works in Baku, Ganja and Sumgayit.
getting_around.es: Bolt funciona en Bakú, Ganja y Sumgayit.
getting_around.quote: The most anticipated provider is Bolt, which works in Baku, Ganja and Sumgayit.

getting_around.en: Azerbaijan has a high number of road accidents, and traffic rules are often not respected.
getting_around.es: Azerbaiyán tiene muchos accidentes de tráfico y a menudo no se respetan las normas.
getting_around.quote: Azerbaijan is a country with a high number of road accidents—traffic rules are often not respected.

money.en: The currency is the New Azerbaijani manat (AZN), and the old manat should not be accepted.
money.es: La moneda es el nuevo manat azerbaiyano (AZN) y no se debe aceptar el manat antiguo.
money.quote: The "old" manat was replaced by the "New Azerbaijani manat" on 1 January 2007, so do not accept old manat.

money.en: Manat and Georgian lari can be changed in towns near the border, and in Georgia.
money.es: El manat y el lari georgiano se pueden cambiar en localidades cercanas a la frontera y en Georgia.
money.quote: Manat and Georgian lari can be changed in towns near the border, and in Georgia.

etiquette.en: When invited into an Azerbaijani home, bring a gift; give an odd number of flowers, as an even number is associated with funerals.
etiquette.es: Al ser invitado a una casa azerbaiyana, lleva un regalo; regala un número impar de flores, pues el par se asocia a funerales.
etiquette.quote: be sure to get an odd number of flowers, as an even number is associated with funerals

etiquette.en: Take off your shoes just outside or inside the door of a home unless the owner explicitly allows otherwise.
etiquette.es: Quítate los zapatos justo fuera o dentro de la puerta de una casa, salvo que el anfitrión permita expresamente lo contrario.
etiquette.quote: When you arrive at the house take off your shoes just outside or immediately inside the door, unless the owner explicitly allows you to keep them on.

etiquette.en: Do not insult or speak badly of the Aliyev family, which is punishable by imprisonment.
etiquette.es: No insultes ni hables mal de la familia Aliyev, lo cual se castiga con prisión.
etiquette.quote: Do not insult or speak badly of the Aliyev family. This is punishable by imprisonment.

etiquette.en: Do not discuss the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict or Armenia, as feelings run strong.
etiquette.es: No hables del conflicto de Nagorno-Karabaj ni de Armenia, pues los sentimientos son intensos.
etiquette.quote: Do not mention or have a discussion about Armenia. Feelings of hatred against Armenians are widespread in Azerbaijan.

etiquette.en: It is respectful to bend slightly when greeting someone older or in a position of authority.
etiquette.es: Es respetuoso inclinarse ligeramente al saludar a alguien mayor o con autoridad.
etiquette.quote: It is respectful to bend slightly (not a complete bow) when greeting someone older or in a position of authority.

etiquette.en: Avoid photographing railways, subway stations and other objects the authorities may think strategic.
etiquette.es: Evita fotografiar ferrocarriles, estaciones de metro y otros objetos que las autoridades puedan considerar estratégicos.
etiquette.quote: Avoid photographing railways, subway stations, and other objects which the authorities may think to be of "strategic"

connectivity.en: Mobile operators include Azercell, Bakcell, Nar Mobile and Azerfon-Vodafone.
connectivity.es: Los operadores móviles incluyen Azercell, Bakcell, Nar Mobile y Azerfon-Vodafone.
connectivity.quote: There are three mobile operators: Azercell, Bakcell, Nar Mobile, Azerfon-Vodafone.

connectivity.en: Only with Azercell can you talk in the Baku metro.
connectivity.es: Solo con Azercell se puede hablar en el metro de Bakú.
connectivity.quote: Only with Azercell can you talk in the metro (subway) in Baku.

connectivity.en: SIM cards for different operators can be bought in almost every store.
connectivity.es: Las tarjetas SIM de distintos operadores se venden en casi todas las tiendas.
connectivity.quote: You can buy cards for use with different operators almost in every store.
